rules.name: noUniqueStart
rules.description: Start without a Unique Skill and use the alternate starting-stat path.

rules.name: trulyUnique
rules.description: Remove already-owned Unique Skills from the reincarnation selection pool.

rules.name: mpSkillCost
rules.description: Percentage of maximum Magicules spent when obtaining a new skill.

rules.name: maximumMagicExplosion
rules.description: Caps the configured Magic Explosion scale used by the core ability system.

rules.name: disableNullification
rules.description: Disable nullification abilities when enabled.

rules.name: skillGriefing
rules.description: Allow skills, magic, and battlewill effects to alter or destroy blocks.

rules.name: skillSteal
rules.description: Allow applicable abilities to steal a player's skill instead of only copying it.

rules.name: epSteal
rules.description: Allow applicable abilities to steal EP from players.

rules.name: playerMindControl
rules.description: Allow applicable abilities to mind-control players.

rules.name: maxMpGain
rules.description: Maximum Magicules an entity may gain from one defeated target.

rules.name: maxApGain
rules.description: Maximum Aura an entity may gain from one defeated target.

rules.name: epGainMultiplier
rules.description: Whole-number multiplier applied to EP gain.

rules.name: playerEP
rules.description: Percentage of a defeated player's base EP used in reward calculations.

rules.name: vanillaEP
rules.description: Percentage of a vanilla mob's base EP used in reward calculations.

rules.name: tensuraEP
rules.description: Percentage of a Tensura mob's base EP used in reward calculations.

rules.name: moddedEP
rules.description: Percentage of another mod's mob EP used in reward calculations.

rules.name: spawnerEP
rules.description: Percentage of base EP granted by mobs created from spawners.

rules.name: epDeathPenalty
rules.description: Percentage of EP lost when a player respawns after death.

rules.name: rimuruMode
rules.description: Use the special Rimuru starting route during reincarnation.

rules.name: hardcoreRace
rules.description: Enable the harder rule set attached to selected races.

rules.name: skillBeforeRace
rules.description: Choose starting skills before choosing a race during reincarnation.

rules.name: disableDaemonAutoMagic
rules.description: Stop daemons from automatically learning aspectual magic during evolution.

rules.name: disableSpiritualLimit
rules.description: Remove the outside-Hell EP limit applied to unnamed, unawakened daemons.

rules.name: tensuraDisplayName
rules.description: Show a player's Tensura-given name as their display name.

rules.name: playerNaming
rules.description: Allow players to receive names through Tensura's naming system.

rules.name: playerSummoning
rules.description: Allow player-targeted summoning behavior registered by the core mod.

rules.name: playerManualDodging
rules.description: Enable the manual player-dodging mode registered by the core mod.

rules.name: demonLordSeed
rules.description: EP threshold for becoming a Demon Lord Seed.

rules.name: demonLordAwaken
rules.description: Soul-point requirement for True Demon Lord awakening.

rules.name: forceHarvestFestival
rules.description: Soul count required to force a Harvest Festival.

rules.name: labyrinthPvp
rules.description: Controls PvP in the core Labyrinth system; TSR does not promote a 1.21.1 player route to this feature.

rules.name: labyrinthDeath
rules.description: Controls normal death versus emergency removal in the core Labyrinth system; TSR does not promote a 1.21.1 player route to this feature.

rules.name: npcGrief
rules.description: Allow humanoid Tensura NPCs to interact with the environment independently of vanilla mob griefing.

rules.name: npcWorking
rules.description: Allow supported Tensura NPC work behaviors.

rules.name: colossusRespawn
rules.description: Controls Elemental Colossus respawning in the core Labyrinth system; TSR does not promote that system as a 1.21.1 feature.

rules.name: resetCounterBonusUnique
rules.description: Number of reset-counter steps used to award an additional starting Unique Skill.

rules.name: resetIncompletePenalty
rules.description: Reset-counter points removed when a reset scroll is used before its requirements are met.

rules.name: resetPerSkillLock
rules.description: Core skill-lock reset value. SlimeThrone Extras intercepts reads and commands and keeps this gamerule at zero.

rules.name: uniqueSECost
rules.description: Require Soul Energy for Mysticism Unique Skill acquisition where the skill implements that cost path.

rules.name: doAscensionUltimate
rules.description: Allow Ascension's registered Ultimate Skill evolution routes to run.

rules.name: nightmare_ultimates
rules.description: Allow Nightmares Ultimate Skill obtainment.

rules.name: god_skills
rules.description: Allow Nightmares God-class skill obtainment.

rules.name: auto_evolve
rules.description: Automatically complete eligible Nightmares skill evolutions instead of waiting for confirmation.

rules.name: trulygodclass
rules.description: Apply the artifact's one-of-one restriction to God-class skills.

rules.name: giftofworld
rules.description: Enable the Nightmares Gift of the World progression behavior.

rules.name: EntityAwakening
rules.description: Allow eligible non-player entities to use the Nightmares awakening system.

rules.name: entityAwakeningMinEp
rules.description: Minimum EP required by the Nightmares entity-awakening path.

rules.name: entityAwakeningSoulPointsRaw
rules.description: Raw stored soul-point requirement used by Nightmares entity awakening.

rules.name: lose_unique_on_upgrade
rules.description: Consume the prior Unique Skill when it upgrades through a Nightmares evolution.

rules.name: uniquetruedragons
rules.description: Apply the artifact's uniqueness rule to Nightmares True Dragon progression.

rules.name: nightmareSoulTraits
rules.description: Enable Nightmares soul-trait assignment and related mechanics.

rules.name: nightmareSoulType
rules.description: Enable Nightmares soul-type assignment and related mechanics.

rules.name: PredGlutGourmtGetFoodChain
rules.description: Allow the registered Predator, Gluttony, and Gourmet route to obtain Food Chain.

rules.name: TrulyNameless
rules.description: Enable the Nightmares nameless-display behavior registered by the artifact.

rules.name: maxDealMakerUsers
rules.description: Maximum number of users supported by a Nightmares Deal Maker relationship.
